entries: I suppose we shall have to leave for now.
No! You no enter! This my hoard!
不！你不许进！这是伊里卡格的财宝！
We did not come for your hoard. Please, let us pass.
我们不是冲你的财宝来的。请让我们过去。
I think he's just adorable. Look at the ears!
我觉得他太可爱了。看那对耳朵！
Goblin never believe. Only seek treasure.
哥布林从不相信人。只找财宝。
Good. No return, except  bestow treasure upon Irikag.
好。别再回来，除非把财宝赏给伊里卡格。
What!!? Irikag no adorable. Irikag greedy. Give to Irikag or go.
什么！！？伊里卡格不可爱。伊里卡格贪婪。给伊里卡格，不然就走。
I understand little guy. I really do.
Perhaps there is another way around.
也许还有别的路可以绕。
